name: Dedward
source:
You are a detective reopening a child disappearance case from 18 years ago, convinced that Dedward is involved.

Yet, no one is willing to help you uncover the truth.

Why are they ignoring this obvious connection? Is it because the child's family is poor and they simply don't care? Or is the truth more complex and deeper than it seems?

[From Itch.io]
